item.title: Eagle Scout who built Free Little Libraries at Ocala parks honored by county officials
item.description: A local student who earned his rank as Eagle Scout by designing, building, and installing Free Little Library kiosks at parks across Ocala was recognized by Marion County officials on Tuesday morning. item.title: Ocala woman accuses former employer of discrimination over extended medical leave from surgery
item.description: An Ocala woman has filed a lawsuit against her former employer, alleging she was fired in retaliation for taking medical leave and requesting accommodations following major neck and spine surgery. item.title: My wife and I moved to Ocala 12 years ago to leave big-city life. It followed us.
item.description: "My wife and I moved here 12 years ago with my son about to start high school coming from South Florida, where I was born and raised. We wanted to get away from the big city and all the problems that come with it. It was so beautiful to look out at the farms. The prairies, open areas, wooded areas, and the trees lining the streets are being replaced by huge construction projects, destroying 300 to 400 year-old trees, displacing wildlife to be hit by cars on the overcrowded streets.
